svg.aria-label: The left side of Lemma I.2 minimized over the admissible states with axial label, as a function of z, with the two lower bounds of the proof: up to pi/6 its value f at the transition state, which is the least value there and lies above its tangent at 0, and the concave m2 from pi/6 to pi/2, which lies above its chord; the right panel magnifies the small turns
